{{Quote|All right. Hey, you! Want to make 20 credits?''"<br />"''Huh?''"<br />"''All you gotta do is walk into that shop. Don't look at it until I've finished talking to you. Walk into that shop, look around, come out, and tell me what you see.|Roark Garnet and the Human|<ref name="RPG" />}}
A '''Human''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xerxes]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], asked the citizen to enter a [[Unidentified weapons shop|weapons shop]] on the planet, take a look around, then report back to him. He offered the [[Human/Legends|Human]] twenty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if they agreed.<ref name="RPG" />
